nodes.description: Nodes metalnap may manage. It touches nothing else.

mode.description: Quote it. Unquoted on/off are YAML booleans and will fail.

hostFormat.description: BMC hostname format; {node} is substituted. A dotted HOSTNAME must end in '.' (absolute) -- musl does not fall back from the search list to the absolute name, so a non-absolute dotted hostname silently fails to resolve and metalnap cannot reach the BMC. IP literals are exempt: they never touch DNS.

silenceLabels.description: Labels a node's alerts name it by; one silence per label, matching <label>=<node>.

silenceMatchers.description: Extra matchers in amtool syntax (name="v", name!="v", name=~"re", name!~"re"), ANDed into every silence.

tolerations.description: Keep this empty. metalnap must never be schedulable onto a node it manages.

powerCycleCooldownS.description: At most one power cycle of a wedged node per node per this long. 0 disables. Must be 0 or at least wakeTimeoutS.

shutdownTimeoutS.description: How long a soft shutdown may take before the node is reported as one that would not power off. Never forced.

maintenance.description: Scheduled wakeups so idle nodes collect updates. Off unless intervalS is set. The node stays cordoned throughout: a visit holds it out of service on purpose.

intervalS.description: Wake a node that has been asleep this long. 0 disables.

windowS.description: How long it stays up, measured from Ready. Must be less than intervalS.

staggerS.description: Per-node spread of the due time, so a rack does not power on in unison.

timeoutS.description: Bound on one visit, from power-on. Must be at least windowS + timers.wakeTimeoutS.

shortfall.description: PromQL for unmet memory, GiB. Empty = read off the unschedulable pods with the scheduler's effective-request formula.

cpuShortfall.description: PromQL for unmet CPU, cores. Empty = read off the unschedulable pods; "-" sizes on memory alone.

saturation.description: PromQL counting work queues at their ceiling. Empty = the ARC default; "-" disables the term.
